summary: Tested backend + mobile-first Expo web flows on public preview. Requested onboarding, auth transition, pipeline dashboard, add-menu/actions, manual save, list rendering, detection navigation, and backend regressions are working after restarting Expo.

integration_issues.issue: Grok API returns 400 invalid key in backend logs; detection correctly falls back to rule parser.

action_items: No blocker found for requested feature set; keep fallback parser behavior documented while Grok key remains invalid.
For reliable verification in this CI preview, restart Expo before final checks so latest UI code is served.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py CORS uses allow_credentials=True with allow_origin_regex='.*'; this can fail stricter browser CORS combinations (observed on localhost origin).
MenuAction in frontend/components/KanbanBoard.tsx uses both onPress and onPressIn on the same action, increasing accidental double-trigger risk on touch/web.
seed_data_creation: Created multiple unique test signup users and test applications through UI/API. Backend regression cleanup test removes API-created applications.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use public preview URL and mobile viewport. If UI appears stale, restart Expo first (CI mode disables watch reloads).
rca_of_issue: Initial mismatch (old board labels/menu behavior) was caused by stale Expo bundle in CI mode; after supervisor restart, requested updated UI rendered and flows passed.
